Question: Set \(u_0 = \dfrac{1}{4},\) and for \(k \ge 0\) let \(u_{k+1}\) be determined by the recurrence \[u_{k+1} = 2u_k - 2u_k^2.\] This sequence tends to a limit; call it \(L.\) What is the least value of \(k\) such that \[|u_k - L| \le \dfrac{1}{2^{1000}}?\]
